title: Unforgettable Whistler ( Full Day Private Tour)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Minimum drinking age in BC is 19 years
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
All lift, gondolas and operation times are weather dependent and subject to change.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is approximately an 8 hour sightseeing adventure. This beautiful scenic drive on the Sea To Sky Highway takes about two and a half hours each way. We will be making a few stops to enjoy breath taking views of water falls. Arriving in Whistler around lunch time. From then on, you will have time to dine and explore the beautiful Village or take the spectacular gondola ride to the top of Whistler Mountain. Once there you may transfer to the Peak to Peak gondola which is now the world's longest unsupported run between two mountains measuring 3 kilometers (1. 8 miles). ( If it is important, please check for Gondola closing dates between seasons for maintenance)
